what_changed: Levitate/Eelevate Ground refusals move from _stepTryHit (step 1) to _stepTypeImm (step 2) and are attributed there; Soundproof/Bulletproof/Overcoat move from _stepTryImm (step 3) to _stepTryHit (step 1).

band.why: THE COUNT IS A LOWER BOUND. A game records only its FIRST divergence, so a game whose immune ordering is fixed can re-enter on a later cause. Any game that leaves and re-enters is a TRANSFER, not a miss, and is recorded as one.

named_risks: BOARD-MATERIAL. Moving the move-class refusal from step 3 to step 1 puts it ABOVE the type chart, so a body that is both sound-immune and type-immune now names its ability instead of printing the bare line, and it now short-circuits before `immunityGateRefuses`. Both match the authority; both are behaviour and not only order. If board-material leaves 0 of 958 this fix is withdrawn and re-cut.

`_explicitFail`. A Levitate refusal now sets it (step 2 does; the absorb path did not). That is the authority's own `atLeastOneFailure`, and it reaches Stomping Tantrum. Correct, and a live change beyond narration.

A Flying-typed Levitate carrier must still announce BARE (Rotom-Fan is legal here). `airborneAbilityRefusing` reads isGrounded's clause ORDER rather than the ability name, so the Flying clause answers first. Not staged by any probe arm; named.
